# Disagreement Log — 1QM Column 9

| # | Line | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Category | Resolution |
|---|------|------|-------|--------|----------|------------|
| 1 | 9:1 | "blood-of the-slain-of the-nations" | "blood of the slain of the nations" | "blood of enemy dead" | Register | SOPHIA: "blood of the slain of the nations" per LOGOS — "enemy dead" loses the Hebrew specificity |
| 2 | 9:2 | "vain-nation" | "worthless nation" | "godless nation" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "worthless nation" — Hebrew naval implies moral worthlessness; "godless" (PNEUMA) narrows to irreligion |
| 3 | 9:3 | "chief-priest" | "chief priest" | "high priest" | Title | SOPHIA: "chief priest" — kohen ha-rosh is literally "head priest," distinct from kohen gadol (high priest) |
| 4 | 9:3 | "elders-of the-arrangement" | "elders of the battle order" | "senior officers" | Terminology | SOPHIA: "elders of the battle order" — "senior officers" (PNEUMA) is too modern-military |
| 5 | 9:4 | "Belial" | "Belial" | "the Devil" | Proper name | SOPHIA: "Belial" preserved as the scroll's own cosmic adversary name |
| 6 | 9:5 | "may-he-be-execrated" | "may he be execrated" | "may he be damned" | Register | SOPHIA: "execrated" — formal liturgical register; "damned" (PNEUMA) is colloquial |
| 7 | 9:6 | "lot-of-darkness... lot-of-God" | "lot of darkness... lot of God" | "realm of darkness... God's people" | Theological term | SOPHIA: "lot of darkness/God" — goral is a key Qumran dualistic term; "realm" and "people" lose the allotment theology |
| 8 | 9:7 | "strengthen the-hands-of" | "strengthen the hands of" | "rallies" | Idiom | SOPHIA: "strengthen the hands of" — preserves the Hebrew military idiom (cf. Judges 9:24) |
| 9 | 9:8 | "time-of-distress" | "time of distress" | "darkest hour" | Register | SOPHIA: "time of distress" — et tsarah is a technical eschatological phrase (cf. Daniel 12:1); "darkest hour" is colloquial |
| 10 | 9:13 | "crucible of-distress" | "crucible of distress" | "fire of suffering" | Imagery | SOPHIA: "crucible of distress" — preserves the metallurgical imagery of the Hebrew kur |
| 11 | 9:14 | "star-of Jacob... scepter" | "star... scepter" | "star... ruler" | Biblical allusion | SOPHIA: "star... scepter" — preserves Numbers 24:17 vocabulary; "ruler" (PNEUMA) interprets the metaphor |
| 12 | 9:15 | "Sons-of-Sheth" | "Sons of Sheth" | "descendants of Seth" | Proper name | SOPHIA: "Sons of Sheth" — preserves the Numbers 24:17 form; "descendants" is interpretive |
| 13 | 9:16 | "anointed-ones, seers-of-appointed-times" | "anointed ones, the seers of appointed times" | "chosen prophets, the ones who announced the appointed times" | Key phrase | SOPHIA: "anointed ones, the seers of appointed times" — meshichim must be preserved; "chosen prophets" loses the anointing language |
| 14 | 9:16 | "battles-of Your-hands" | "battles of Your hands" | "holy wars" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "battles of Your hands" — "holy wars" (PNEUMA) is a loaded modern term absent from the Hebrew |
